title: Meow email sign-up
description: A one-field sign-up bar: a 4px-cornered box holding a large email input and a filled button tucked inside its right end. Frosted light on dark heroes, white with a hairline on light bands; the button in the brand orange or the blue accent.
notes: a plain GET form to `action`; no JavaScript
frost is meant for dark backdrops
name: meow-email-form

props.name: placeholder
props.description: the hint inside the field, e.g. "Your work email"

props.name: label
props.description: the field's label for screen readers

props.name: surface
props.description: frost: light, see-through box for dark backdrops · card: white box with a hairline

props.name: tone
props.description: the button's colour: primary (orange) or accent (blue)
